Vine Ladder Ascent.name: Vine Ladder Ascent
Vine Ladder Ascent.description: The user loops vine bundles around a sturdy railing up to five meters above and pulls upward while climbing with hands and feet. The ascent takes one turn and needs a clear path and an anchor that bears the user's weight. A failed anchor or severed bundle drops the user, and the pull strains the scalp and neck. Strain: moderate.
